notes.title: Update 3/6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new enemy: bats
[*] Reworked how drop rates are calculated, so rare items are now rarer
[list][*]The old method did not account for loot pool sizes, so even though (for a tier 1 chest) Common items had a 3.18% drop rate and Uncommon items had a 2.55% drop rate, an individual drop had a 30.24% chance of being [i]any[/i] Common item, and a 35.68% chance of being [i]any[/i] Uncommon item
[*]The new method keeps the ratios of each rarity constant by reducing individual items' drop rates
[*]In other words: adding an Uncommon item will now reduce the drop rates of other Uncommon items, but the odds of getting [i]any[/i] Uncommon item will remain the same[/list]
[*] Upgraded to Godot 4.4
[list][*]This brings several performance improvements, the most noticeable of which is the game will no longer hang for a few seconds when unlocking doors on large floors[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 12/12
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Overhauled how items are equipped
[list]
[*] Removed item shortcuts
[*] There are now radial menus for choosing main hand items (1/R1), offhand items (2/L1), and consumables (3/D-pad down)
[*] On controller, quick weapon swapping has been moved from L1/R1 to D-pad left/D-pad right
[*] You may need to reset input bindings for these changes to take effect
[/list]
[*] There is now a button to quickly consume a healing potion (Q/D-pad up)
[*] More verbose logging while generating floors to (hopefully) help diagnose a rare crash
[*] Mouse sensitivity is now independent of window size
[*] Controller sensitivity has been reduced by 75%
[list]
[*] What was I thinking
[*] If you liked your old sensitivity, just multiply it by 4
[*] If your old sensitivity was 2.5 or more, please reconsider
[/list]
[*] Fixed bug where you would become softlocked if hit with lethal damage while swapping weapons
[*] Crosshair now hides while in menus
[*] Mouse cursor now remains hidden while using controller
[*] Fixed dropping a weapon while attacking with it not removing it from your hand
[*] On controller, B/Circle now closes menus
[*] Adjusted enemy spawn rates
[*] Reduced damage of King's Reach
[*] Added a unique axe
[/list]

notes.title: Update 11/21
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added status effects that can be inflicted on enemies: Burn, Freeze, Shock, and Illuminate
[*] Enemies now clearly show when they have been staggered or inflicted with a status condition
[*] The "Dielectric Breakdown" perk has been reworked to now inflict the Shock status
[*] New perks have been added to inflict the Freeze, Shock, and Illuminate statuses
[*] 2 new variants of the Elemental Staff have been added
[*] Adjusted enemy spawn rates so rarer enemies appear more often

[list]
[*] This was in the patch notes for the previous update but wasn't actually included. I'm sorry for my dishonesty and I will do better
[/list]
[*] Fix projectiles getting stuck when moving nearly-parallel to a wall
[*] Fix drawn bows firing when switching weapons
[*] Fix fully-charged staffs firing when changing weapons or running out of stamina
[*] It is no longer possible to swap weapons while mid-attack with a melee weapon
[list]
[*] This is to prevent hot-swapping to attack faster than intended
[*] This may make switching weapons feel more difficult, in the future I may look into buffering the swap input or allowing swapping during the "follow-through" animation
[/list]
[*] Enemies' anti-stunlock stagger resistance now stacks exponentially
[/list]
